decisions.statement: Both apps run these same assertions rather than each carrying its own copy.
A harness is handed the name and whether the check held and the reading the check saw.
The rule asserted is the one the provider calls rather than a copy of it.
A feed stating its own moment and a feed stating none are both asserted.
The provider's own timeline is compiled here and never run.
The cost feed asked is the app's own rather than one written again here.
A harness that names no cost widget has no cost feed for these to reach.
This component is compiled by the harnesses rather than by either app.

definition: what both harnesses assert of the entries a feed's timeline is made of
